title: The multi-band battle tour with Basie, Moten and Chick Webb
summary: He describes a tour of several bands, including Moten, Chick Webb and Zack Whyte, battling at one-nighters.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: I used to sing pretty regular with the band you know. And -- (inaudible) -- it seems like we teamed up here again and there was a five band tour of (inaudible) -- originally it was Count Basie (PHONETIC) you know.

Chick Webb (PHONETIC), three of them. Zack White was four. And -- first it was (unintelligible) -- but I think we had out of town bands to start out with. We had, we had Johnson's out of Richmond, Virginia. And I'm trying to think of a couple of names. (Inaudible).
Bennie Moten (PHONETIC). I think there was Bennie Moten (PHONETIC). Zack White, Chick Webb (PHONETIC), and the fifth band -- I'm trying to -- maybe it was Johnson's on that tour.
But there was supposed to have been seven bands on that tour I think. I'm trying to think of what that other band was.
What kind of a tour was it -- they -- there would be so many bands in it?
It was -- you remember when they used to have battles of bands? When they used -- this band battling the other band. That's what it was.
And they all played at the same place in one night. You know -- one-nighters. But they had some big crowds coming. And --
Would people come to those things as much to listen as to dance?
Yeah. Oh yeah. Yeah. And Bennie Moten (PHONETIC) used to break it up with the Moten swing.
